meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

examples.text: 详细流程我们再过一遍，我觉得这个时间上可能有点问题。
examples.trans: Let's run through the detailed rundown one more time; I think the timing might be tight.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.en: to come up; to move upward toward the speaker
meanings.note: shànglái — used as a standalone verb indicating movement from a lower to a higher position toward the speaker.

meanings.en: up; forward; to a higher authority (directional complement)
meanings.note: shànglai — placed after an action verb (e.g., 交上来 'hand in', 拿上来 'bring up') to indicate submission to a superior or movement into view.

examples.text: 接下来抓紧时间，把最终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Next, make good use of the time and hand in the final draft.

examples.text: 他们总监是绝对不会把真正的方案拿上来的。
examples.trans: Their director will never hand over their real proposal willingly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.text: 老搭档之间只要一个眼神就能明白对方的意思。
examples.trans: Between longtime partners, a single glance is enough to understand what the other means.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ hòu. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以后的时间 ('time afterward').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Describes low height, volume, or pitch (声音很低 'voice is low').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 她说话的声音很低。
examples.trans: Her speaking voice is very soft and low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.en: to vibrate in resonance (acoustics); to feel shared emotion
meanings.note: Pinyin: gòng míng. Describes both physical strings humming together and hearts responding to art or words.

examples.text: 太好听了！听见胡桃木下排的琴弦在我高音旋律底下嗡嗡共鸣了吗？
examples.trans: Lovely! Do you hear the lower walnut strings humming richly beneath my upper melody?

examples.text: 老教授讲起三十年前的小院往事，院子里人人心里都产生共鸣。
examples.trans: When the old professor told stories of the courtyard thirty years ago, everyone felt a deep resonance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Describes pleasantly cool air or hot water/food that has cooled down (放凉).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì tú. Functions both as a field noun (制图教授, cartography professor) and as an action ('to draw maps').

examples.text: 真棒，志豪！你的制图老教授听了，肯定笑得合不拢嘴！
examples.trans: Bravo, Hao! Your old cartography professor is going to smile from ear to ear!

examples.text: 老先生拿出随身带的制图铅笔，在餐巾纸角上画了条小巷。
examples.trans: The elderly gentleman took out his drafting pencil and sketched a small lane on the corner of a napkin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí èr. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 二 ('two').

examples.text: 阳光房里一共可以摆十二把木椅。
examples.trans: Twelve wooden chairs in all can be arranged in the sunroom.

examples.text: 一年有十二个月。
examples.trans: There are twelve months in a year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí liù. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 六 ('six').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲最后还缺少十六个小节。
examples.trans: This waltz is still missing sixteen bars at the end.

examples.text: 茶壶里泡的薄荷茶够倒十六小杯。
examples.trans: The mint tea steeped in the teapot is enough to pour sixteen small cups.

口气.gloss: tone of voice; pent-up frustration (in 咽下这口气)

meanings.en: tone of voice; pent-up frustration (in 咽下这口气)
meanings.note: Used both for manner of speaking and stomaching an insult.

examples.text: 受了这么大的委屈，谁都没法轻易咽下这口气。
examples.trans: Wronged that badly, nobody could swallow the insult easily.

examples.text: 和合作伙伴沟通时请注意说话的口气。
examples.trans: Mind your tone of voice when speaking with partners.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu shǒu. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只右手 ('a right hand').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 进大门往右手边看就是前台。
examples.trans: Step through the main gate and look to your right for the front desk.

合不拢嘴.gloss: grinning from ear to ear; unable to close one's mouth

meanings.en: grinning from ear to ear; unable to close one's mouth
meanings.note: Pinyin: hé bu lǒng zuǐ. Idiomatic potential complement phrase 合不拢 ('unable to bring together/close') + 嘴 ('mouth'), almost always after 笑得 ('smiling so wide that...').

examples.text: 周经理站在院子中间，看着新挂好的绿窗板笑得合不拢嘴！
examples.trans: Standing in the middle of the courtyard, Manager Zhou grinned from ear to ear at the newly hung green shutters!

examples.text: 听到办事员夸奖柠檬挞好吃，小美高兴得合不拢嘴。
examples.trans: Hearing the clerk praise the lemon tart, Mei beamed from ear to ear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng jiàn. Result compound: 听 ('listen') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually hear'.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 关上木窗就听不见外面的车声了。
examples.trans: Close the wooden window and you cannot hear the street traffic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个吸。
examples.trans: I have a 吸.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的吸。
examples.trans: This is a very good 吸.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé xián. Combines 和 ('harmonious/together') + 弦 ('musical string'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 最后一个温柔的和弦，高一个八度——又回家了。
examples.trans: And there is our gentle final chord, one octave higher—home again.

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上轻轻弹下第一个温暖的大调和弦。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently played the first warm major chord on the piano.

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Colloquial pronoun zánliǎ ('you and I, the two of us').

examples.text: 咱俩都分手两年了。
examples.trans: The two of us broke up two years ago.

examples.text: 咱俩一起去喝杯茶吧。
examples.trans: Let the two of us go get a cup of tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Verb chàng ('sing').

examples.text: 二位真是说得比唱得好听。
examples.trans: The two of you talk even sweeter than singing.

examples.text: 今晚压轴嘉宾会现场唱两首新歌。
examples.trans: Tonight's finale guest will sing two new songs live.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuǎn. Pairs with 气 in 喘口气 ('catch one's breath').

examples.text: 老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
examples.trans: Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!

examples.text: 他跑上三楼，先喘一口气。
examples.trans: He ran up to the third floor and paused to catch his breath.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēng wēng. Onomatopoeia describing the low hum of an appliance, bee, or transformer.

examples.text: 新冰箱在角落里轻轻地嗡嗡响。
examples.trans: The new fridge hums softly in the corner.

examples.text: 春天花园里的蜜蜂在花朵旁嗡嗡飞。
examples.trans: In spring, bees in the garden buzz around the blossoms.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: four-hand piano duet played together on one keyboard
meanings.note: Pinyin: sì shǒu lián tán. Literally 'four hands linked playing,' naming two pianists sharing one piano bench.

examples.text: 下午四点我和宋老师把四手联弹钢琴曲最后排练一遍！
examples.trans: And at four this afternoon Song and I run through our four-hand piano duet one last time!

examples.text: 只剩三个小时了！蛋糕还只是面糊，四手联弹也只排了一半！
examples.trans: Only three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is only half rehearsed!

meanings.en: see you later; catch you soon
meanings.note: Pinyin: huítóu jiàn. Casual, friendly parting phrase where 回头 figuratively means 'in a little while' or 'later on'; common among coworkers and friends expecting to meet again soon.

examples.text: 我先去开会了，咱们回头见！
examples.trans: I'm heading off to my meeting first — see you later!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，回头见！
examples.trans: It was great chatting today; see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Neutral-tone structural particle turning a descriptive phrase into an adverb before a verb (轻轻地放 'set down gently'); distinct from noun di4 ('ground').

examples.text: 小晴整整齐齐地把茶杯排在木架上。
examples.trans: Qing arranged the teacups neatly on the wooden shelf.

examples.text: 老陈仔细地检查了每一根新电线。
examples.trans: Chen carefully checked every single new wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外头院子 ('the space outside').

examples.text: 有人吗？晚上好！大门前根本没人啊！
examples.trans: Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!

examples.text: 周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look out the courtyard window—someone just ran in the gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Prefix/noun tóu ('first, initial; head').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first line at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这是我头一回进大型演播室。
examples.trans: This is my very first time inside a major TV studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo tīng. Built from 好 ('good') + 听 ('listen'); compare 好看 ('good-looking') and 好吃 ('tasty').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 你的声音真好听。
examples.trans: Your voice sounds really lovely.

子.gloss: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)

meanings.en: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zi. Neutral-tone noun suffix attached to roots such as 桌 ('table'), 椅 ('chair'), 盘 ('plate'), and 罐 ('jar').

examples.text: 晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
examples.trans: Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and acoustic panels together!

examples.text: 院子里的木桌子和竹椅子都已经擦得干干净净了。
examples.trans: The wooden tables and bamboo chairs in the courtyard have all been wiped spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xīn. Literally 'small heart'—pay close attention.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo jié. In music notation, counts bars/measures between vertical barlines (二十四小节 'twenty-four bars').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的前八个小节特别轻快。
examples.trans: The opening eight bars of this waltz are especially light and lively.

examples.text: 宋老师用铅笔在第四小节旁边做了记号。
examples.trans: Teacher Song made a pencil mark beside the fourth bar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù xiàng. Introduces a vivid comparison.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 住在这里就像回到自己家一样舒服。
examples.trans: Staying here feels just as cozy as coming home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǐ zi. Combines 尺 ('measuring rule / Chinese foot') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 志鹏开玩笑说，志豪真会拿一把尺子去量每一颗胡萝卜丁！
examples.trans: Peng joked that Hao really would take a ruler to measure every single cube of diced carrot!

examples.text: 挂欢迎木牌以前，老陈先用尺子量好了门框两边的高度。
examples.trans: Before hanging the welcome sign, Chen used a ruler to measure the height on both sides of the doorframe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suì. Measure word for age; follows numbers directly without 个 (八十岁 'eighty years old').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这位老木匠今年七十岁了。
examples.trans: This veteran carpenter is seventy years old this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ shǒu. Combines 左 ('left') + 手 ('hand').

examples.text: 你的咖啡杯就在你左手里拿着呢！
examples.trans: Your coffee cup is right there in your left hand!

examples.text: 弹圆舞曲的时候，左手负责稳定的三拍子节奏。
examples.trans: When playing a waltz, the left hand keeps the steady three-beat rhythm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn zhù shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位建筑师 ('an architect').

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wān. Used as a stative/resultative complement (掰弯 'bend out of shape') or verb (转弯 'turn a corner').

examples.text: 我们生怕用力太猛，把彩绘铁盒盖子掰弯了。
examples.trans: We were afraid of using too much force and bending the painted tin lid.

examples.text: 窄窄的石头小巷往南拐了一个弯。
examples.trans: The narrow cobbled lane curved around to the south.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán. Used for playing the piano or guitar (弹钢琴 'play the piano').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi fēng. Combines 微 ('gentle/slight') + 风 ('wind/breeze'); measure word: 阵 (zhèn) or 缕 (lǚ).

examples.text: 窗户全都大敞开了，下午温暖的微风轻轻吹进九号房。
examples.trans: All the windows are wide open, and the warm afternoon breeze blows gently into Room Nine.

examples.text: 傍晚的微风吹过院子，带来了柠檬挞和薄荷茶的清香。
examples.trans: The evening breeze blew across the courtyard, carrying the fresh scent of lemon tarts and mint tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗心 ('a heart').

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí. Describes rushing or feeling anxious.

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.en: want to; would like to; think; miss
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Before a verb, expresses a polite wish ('would like to'); before a noun/person, 'think of / miss'.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: reduplicated verb for doing an action a little bit

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个我的。
examples.trans: I have a 我的.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的我的。
examples.trans: This is a very good 我的.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎng. Used playfully for 'poaching staff' (抢人) or rushing to grab the bill.

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: Polite word for expressing regret or apology.

examples.text: 让你久等了，我感到非常抱歉。
examples.trans: I am very sorry to have kept you waiting so long.

examples.text: 请帮我向大家说一声抱歉。
examples.trans: Please say sorry to everyone on my behalf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pāi. Used for clapping (拍手), patting someone, and taking photos (拍照).

examples.text: 您拍一下手——听，街上的声音多安静！
examples.trans: Clap your hands once—listen, how quiet the street sounds!

examples.text: 大家拍拍手，欢迎新同事！
examples.trans: Everyone, give a clap to welcome our new colleague!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎi. Everyday direction verb (往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng chuāng. Combines 拱 ('arch') + 窗 ('window').

examples.text: 九号房高高的拱窗擦干净以后透进满屋阳光。
examples.trans: Once Room Nine's tall arched windows were wiped clean, sunlight flooded the room.

examples.text: 站在木梯子上正好能够到拱窗的最顶端。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder lets you reach right to the top of the arched window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái. Counts rows of keys, seats, or houses (一排钥匙 'a row of keys').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 墙上整整齐齐挂着一排钥匙。
examples.trans: A neat row of keys hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā dàng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位搭档 ('a partner').

examples.text: 三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
examples.trans: Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.

examples.text: 小晴和老陈已经是配合默契的好搭档了。
examples.trans: Qing and Chen have already become a great team.

meanings.en: to sway back and forth; rock or wobble
meanings.note: Pinyin: yáo huàng. Combines 摇 (shake, sway) and 晃 (sway, flicker) for rhythmic motion in a breeze.

examples.text: 别老想着尺子，想想院子里那棵大树在星期五微风里轻轻摇晃的样子。
examples.trans: Forget the ruler—picture the big courtyard tree swaying softly in the Friday breeze.

examples.text: 加上木隔档以后，屋檐下的纸灯笼只随着风轻轻摇晃，再也不打绞。
examples.trans: After adding the wooden spacers, the paper lanterns only swayed gently in the breeze without tangling.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pronounced jiàoshòu; placed after a surname when used as a form of address (e.g., 方教授 'Professor Fang').
Pronounced jiàoshòu (or jiāoshòu in older usage) as a formal transitive verb meaning 'to impart knowledge or skills'.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 小谷同学，先来认识一下学位评委的各位教授。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, come meet the professors on the degree committee first.

meanings.note: Noun shù ('count; certainty in 心里有数').

examples.text: 你以为雷总心里一点数都没有吗？
examples.trans: Do you think Director Lei has no idea what goes on?

examples.text: 经费还剩多少，我心里有数。
examples.trans: I have a clear count of how much budget remains.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuán lǜ. Musical melody or tune. Measure word: 段 (duàn, 'passage/melody').

examples.text: 这段钢琴旋律听起来既温柔又熟悉。
examples.trans: This piano melody sounds both gentle and familiar.

examples.text: 哪怕过了很多年，我还是记得那首歌的旋律。
examples.trans: Even after many years, I still remember the melody of that song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuán nuǎn. Affectionate reduplicated verb (暖暖身子 'warm yourself up').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 先喝碗热汤暖暖手和胃吧。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup first to warm up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shùyīn. Measure word: 片.

examples.text: 老人在树荫下乘凉。
examples.trans: The old man is enjoying the cool breeze in the shade of the tree.

examples.text: 夏天的午后，树荫里非常凉快。
examples.trans: On summer afternoons, it is very cool in the shade of the trees.

meanings.note: Noun yàngzi ('state, appearance').

examples.text: 怎么现在变成这个样子了？
examples.trans: How did things turn into this state now?

examples.text: 看他胸有成竹的样子，一定想到办法了。
examples.trans: Seeing his calm look, he must have found a solution.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng. Warm colloquial adjective for praising food, work, or ideas (太棒了！).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

棵.gloss: measure word for trees and plants

meanings.en: measure word for trees and plants
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Standard botanical classifier for individual trees, cabbages, or herbs rooted in the ground (这棵大树 'this big tree').

examples.text: 挂上绿窗板以后，九号房就像本来就属于院子里这棵大树一样！
examples.trans: With the green shutters hung, Room Nine looks as though it belonged to this big courtyard tree all along!

examples.text: 老陈年轻的时候亲手在院子中央种下了这棵梧桐树。
examples.trans: When Chen was young, he planted this wutong tree in the center of the courtyard with his own hands.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.en: to die; to pass away; (figuratively) to be finished or doomed
meanings.note: sǐ — in workplace banter (as in 下周你就死了), often used hyperbolically to mean being eliminated, fired, or doomed in a competition.
Follows adjectives or psychological verbs with 了 to express extreme degree, e.g., 累死了 (dead tired), 吓死了 (scared to death).

examples.text: 用不着了，下周你就死了。
examples.trans: You will not need that anymore — next week you are dead.

examples.text: 这几天连续加班，真是累死我了。
examples.trans: Working overtime for several days straight has completely exhausted me.

examples.text: 外卡？每个导师确实有个外卡名额，但是你之前已经放弃了。
examples.trans: A wild card? Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi cì. Combines 每 ('every') + 次 ('time/occasion'), usually followed by 都 in the main clause.

examples.text: 小时候擦窗户，你每次都把水溅到我衬衫上！
examples.trans: When we washed windows as kids, you splashed water on my shirt every single time!

examples.text: 每次闻到烤柠檬挞的香味，大家都想进厨房看看。
examples.trans: Every time people smell baking lemon tarts, everyone wants to peek into the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāng guǒ. Measure word: 颗 (kē) for a single berry, e.g. 一颗红浆果 ('a red berry').

examples.text: 搭档，趁浆果蛋糕在树荫下放凉，咱们从头再来一遍！
examples.trans: Partner, let us take it from the top one more time while those berry cakes cool in the shade!

examples.text: 小美一早就挑了最新鲜的浆果，准备烤给大家配红茶吃。
examples.trans: First thing in the morning Mei picked the freshest berries to bake for everyone with black tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn. Describes deep breaths (深呼吸) or dark shades of color (深蓝色 'dark blue').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个烤盘 ('a 烤盘').

examples.text: 我有一个烤盘。
examples.trans: I have a 烤盘.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的烤盘。
examples.trans: This is a very good 烤盘.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín xián. Combines 琴 ('stringed/keyboard instrument') + 弦 ('taut string').

examples.text: 哆音的琴槌稳稳抬起来，敲中了三根明亮的琴弦。
examples.trans: The C hammer rose smoothly and struck the three bright piano strings.

examples.text: 调音的时候要轻轻转动扳手，免得拉断旧琴弦。
examples.trans: Turn the wrench gently while tuning so you don't snap an old piano string.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵砖墙 ('a brick wall').

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng hu. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗户 ('a window').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xiào ('smile, laugh').

examples.text: 你看着我的笔记笑什么？
examples.trans: Why are you smiling at my notes?

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家都开心地笑了。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone smiled happily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Verb dá ('answer questions').

examples.text: 给你十分钟时间，先答我几个问题。
examples.trans: Ten minutes—answer a few questions for me first.

examples.text: 面对评委犀利的追问，选手对答得十分从容。
examples.trans: Facing sharp judge questions, the contestant answered calmly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ. As a measure word after numbers, means 'meter' (十米 'ten meters'); as a noun, 'uncooked rice'.

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 五金店就在前面五十米的地方。
examples.trans: The hardware store is fifty meters ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Colloquial noun phrase lǎomáobìng ('old recurring complaint').

examples.text: 胃疼是老毛病了，已经三年了。
examples.trans: Stomach pain is an old ailment I have had for three years.

examples.text: 一紧张就语速加快是不少新主持人的老毛病。
examples.trans: Speaking too fast when nervous is a classic rookie habit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kěn dìng. Colloquial cousin of 一定 for confident predictions.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.en: walnut wood; dark fine-grained timber used for pianos and frames
meanings.note: Pinyin: hú táo mù. Modifies furniture directly, e.g. 胡桃木钢琴 ('walnut piano').

examples.text: 快告诉我志豪躲哪儿去了——咱们得在那架胡桃木钢琴前实打实练够三十分钟！
examples.trans: Now tell me where Hao is hiding—we need thirty solid minutes at that walnut piano!

examples.text: 这张地图镶在温润的胡桃木画框里，挂在白墙上特别精神。
examples.trans: Set inside its warm walnut frame, the map looks striking hanging on the white lobby wall.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective zìrán ('naturally, of its own accord').

examples.text: 不理它，谣言自然就过去了。
examples.trans: Ignore it, and the rumour will naturally pass.

examples.text: 她在镜头前表现得很自然。
examples.trans: She acts very naturally in front of the camera.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì de. Describes recalling something from memory.

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 这么多年过去了，您还记得？
examples.trans: After all these years, you still remember that?

examples.text: 调时间。
examples.trans: Adjust time.

examples.text: 调一下。
examples.trans: Adjust a bit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn. Read zhuàn for spinning wheels or quick wits (脑子转得快 'mind works fast').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 风一吹，纸风车就飞快地转起来。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the paper pinwheel spins fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò dù. Literally 过 ('cross over') + 渡 ('ferry across a river'): a connecting transition or musical bridge (过渡段 'transition passage') between two sections.

examples.text: 听我弹一下钢琴上接到第二十八小节的那段过渡段。
examples.trans: Listen to me play the transition passage on the piano that leads into bar twenty-eight.

examples.text: 宋老师写了四个温暖的和弦，让前半段和后半段之间的过渡非常自然。
examples.trans: Teacher Song wrote four warm chords that make the transition between the first and second halves completely natural.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 最想搞掉的就是那个淳于乔。
examples.trans: The one you want to take down most is that Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 靠墙的那个深蓝色皮箱是昨天傍晚刚寄到的。
examples.trans: That dark blue leather suitcase against the wall just arrived yesterday evening.

meanings.note: Demonstrative nàyàng ('in that state or manner').

examples.text: 别装了，看你一天到晚魂不守舍那样。
examples.trans: Stop pretending — look how distracted you act all day.

examples.text: 事情没有你担心的那样复杂。
examples.trans: Things are not as complicated as you worry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèn. Everyday verb for asking a question (请问 'may I ask').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个音 ('a musical note').

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

examples.text: 这架老钢琴每个音都很准。
examples.trans: Every note on this old piano is right in tune.

meanings.en: smoothly, seamlessly, and without a single snag
meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn shùn dāng dāng. AABB reduplication of 顺当 ('smooth; trouble-free').

examples.text: 一、二、接上……哎呀，中间那颗亮音就在咱俩手心之间顺顺当当唱出来了！
examples.trans: One, two, step in... hey, that bright middle note sang out smoothly right between our hands!

examples.text: 整场欢迎会从头到尾顺顺当当，每位客人都笑得合不拢嘴。
examples.trans: The whole welcome celebration went off without a hitch from start to finish, leaving every guest grinning.

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎ shàng. Literally 'on horseback'—everyday word for 'right now!'.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?
